# Getting help

For setup questions, usage guidance, and ideas:

- Start a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/sabarinath1805-loyal/Vaultr-AI/discussions).
- Search existing [Issues](https://github.com/sabarinath1805-loyal/Vaultr-AI/issues) before opening a new one.
- Read the [README](../README.md), [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md), and `docs/private-mode.md`.

Please do not use public issues for private security reports, credentials, client documents, account-specific support, or general questions that belong in Discussions. Never paste API keys, Supabase service-role keys, legal documents, or personally identifying information into an issue.
